input.answer: Canada's CPI gasoline index rose 27.8% from September 2025 to September 2026. It went from 209.4 to 267.6. Calculation: (267.6 − 209.4) / 209.4 = 58.2 / 209.4 = 0.278, or 27.8%. The data are not seasonally adjusted.

answer_values.label: change_pct
answer_values.description: Gasoline CPI, Canada, % change Sep 2025 to Sep 2026
